summary.verdict: STRUCTURE adds a genuine ORTHOGONAL signal where SEQUENCE fails (a MODEST, honestly-bounded improvement — NOT a decisive ceiling-break): on all 4 phylogenetically-isolated pathogens, structural homology (Foldseek TM) discriminates targets better than sequence (pooled AUROC structure-TM 0.6903 vs sequence 0.6403, a modest +0.05, consistent 4/4), and of the 65 targets SEQUENCE could not see at all (no mmseqs homolog — the TID3 silent-failure cases), STRUCTURE recovers 29 (0.446) via a same-fold (TM>=0.5) reference-target homolog. So structure is a REAL orthogonal signal for the isolated-pathogen case that broke sequence-based target-ID — a partial rescue, not a solution. SPECIFICITY CONFIRMED by the structural-conservation null (run_null.py, reproduced x2): structure-to-TARGETS (AUROC 0.69) beats a matched random NON-target reference (0.56, near-random), delta +0.13 consistent 4/4 — so the signal is target-SPECIFIC, NOT generic 'target-like fold' (the TID1 sequence-conservation critique does NOT carry over to structure here). Provider promoted to OWN_REPRODUCED. Further caveats: modest effect; Foldseek E-values under-estimated (led with TM-score); AlphaFold predicted structures; hypotheses, not validated targets; not wet-lab.
